purpose: Reusable video font pack for current and future Remotion templates.

usage.video_explainer: Use Inter/Montserrat for UI text, Bebas Neue/Anton/Oswald for big headline words, Barlow Condensed for badges and compact labels.
usage.video_caption: Use Inter for clean captions, Montserrat for support labels, Bebas Neue/Anton for bold creator-style emphasis.
usage.handwritten_notes: Use Poppins for readable body, Kalam/Caveat/Patrick Hand for handwritten notes and marker-like headings.
usage.coding_templates: Use JetBrains Mono, Fira Code, or IBM Plex Mono for code, terminal, database, API, and HTML/CSS lessons.
